name: search-engines
description: Get a site into Google and Bing: Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and IndexNow through their APIs
notes: No synced sources. The guides are authored from the Search Console and Site Verification API discovery documents (searchconsole.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1, googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/siteVerification/v1/rest), the Bing Webmaster API reference on learn.microsoft.com and the IndexNow protocol at indexnow.org
